## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved
- Package members: release — docs/design/release/release.md; system — docs/design/system/system.md; design — docs/design/design/design.md; published-skill-first-release-amendment — specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.md. Exact current member and governing subjects are stored.
- Upstream review ID: proposal-review-r5, approved/current on its exact renewed basis.
- Review ID and round: design-review-r5, round 5.
- Material findings: none new; earlier findings retain their explicit resolved dispositions and original subjects.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded through targeted review operation on successful save.
- Open blockers: none.
- Immediate next stage: Route/authorized Delivery execution; this review makes no activity/work transition.
- Claim limitations: bounded Design applicability renewal. It does not establish M4 removal completion, implementation correctness, final adoption, Verify, remote setup or publication readiness.

## Exact factual amendment assessment

Release's building-block view now names release_candidate.py, release_execution.py, release_coordination.py and release-coordinator.py, and describes main-branch preparation followed by one protected executor instead of the superseded tag-triggered implementation. Bounded current workflow/module inspection supports these factual responsibility labels: the workflow triggers on main, prepares the candidate and places execution in the release environment; candidate/execution/coordination entrypoints exist. This is not a substitute for independent milestone implementation assessment.

The Release consumer row and System responsibility row link coordinated adoption to successful final Verify in the owning change. Read with the unchanged introduction/adoption conditions, they describe the condition establishing ownership, not a claim that Verify has already succeeded. The amendments do not change requirement IDs, normative behavior, decisions, source-displacement maps, scenarios, approved scope or proof allocation. They remove stale orientation while preserving the authoritative adoption boundary.

The exact four-member package remains coherent: one complete routine operation, explicit narrower routine eligibility, candidate-specific authorization, S/C and derived overlay identity, archives-to-bundled-metadata-to-tarball build order, separate durable evidence, unavailable-duration diagnostic policy, and retained public-safety/recovery facts. System references the local owner; Design supplies the bounded retention rule; the mixed R7/R8 source preserves its precise new-profile-only ownership disposition. No extra Design member or reclassification of the legacy amendment is required for these factual changes.

## Current reliance and mapped source retirement

This current Design judgment rests on the complete reconciled rules, meaningful decisions and precise displacement/consumer obligations in the current package, under the current proposal and governing policy. The six mapped original specifications/test specifications/ADRs are not required engineering subjects for continued reliance on this judgment after their authorized removal. Their surviving meaning has been independently reconciled during the earlier full-source review and remains present in the unchanged map and retained contract. The present factual update does not change that transfer.

Earlier review subjects and judgments remain exact historical evidence. This record does not retarget those assessments to replacement text, erase their concerns, or assert that historical reviews approved current implementation. Current reliance on the package's source-transfer decision no longer requires the original source files to remain in the checkout. This disposition concerns this reviewer's Design assessment only; other assessors retain ownership of their own reliance decisions.

Actual removal and reader reconciliation are still M4 work: verify the exact six files and scoped architecture boundaries, preserve operational baseline/schema/fixtures and unrelated history, classify references by real use and resolve a discovered necessary reader before deletion. The map authorizes no seventh implicit removal. Milestone Code Review, fresh final whole-change Code Review and distinct successful Verify must establish actual adoption. If implementation exposes missing meaning or a contradiction, return to its owner and reassess rather than rely on this approval to dismiss it.

## Independence, checks and limits

The original independent reviewer remains a nonauthor. Parent authored the factual corrections; this reviewer edited no model, proposal, activity/work or implementation. R4 remains original/stale. This new review records current subjects and a current judgment rather than restoring old approval by changing its identities. Proposal Review r5 independently renews upstream reliance. Design and the scoped R7/R8 amendment remain unchanged; the complete prior package assessment remains substantively applicable to their relationships because the present delta is factual orientation/adoption wording only.

Commands actually used: git diff for the two changed models and git status; bounded M4 plan/source reads; current release workflow and named-module responsibility inspection; primary context and exact subject inspect; targeted review recording. Structural record validation and git diff --check follow saving. No runtime, package build, live smoke, publication or new remote-capability verification was performed. No project-map or whole-repository conformance claim is used. Existing independent implementation evidence remains separately assessed by Code Review/Verify; this Design review neither refreshes its tests nor claims hosted success.
independence_basis: Same independent nonauthor reviewer; parent authored factual member corrections. This assessment writes only its own current judgment/applicability and does not edit engineering or routing.
